paragraphs.sourceText: During the summer, when I was a visiting poet at a residency out of state, an angry, confused woman wandered into my class and said: “I have three guns and I want to use them.” We all 26 . It wasn’t clear if she had the guns, but we each know that, when we teach in America, we are already in danger.
paragraphs.translationZh: 那年夏天，当我在州外的一个驻地做客座诗人时，一位愤怒而困惑的女士走进我的班级，说道：“我有三把枪，我想使用它们。”我们都愣住了。目前还不清楚她是否有枪，但我们都知道，当我们在美国教书时，我们已经处于危险之中。

paragraphs.sourceText: I was dizzy with fear. The woman, who later turned out to be a schizophrenic (精神分裂症患者) without 27 to her medications, was, by some force, wrestled out and 28 away, then put in a hospital for observation, in a step that was actually safer for everyone than any one of us pressing charges. My class went on; we talked about poems. But despite the fact that the rest of our days on campus passed 29 , I was rattled. I couldn’t shake the sense that in this country we always live at 30 risk.
paragraphs.translationZh: 我吓得头晕。这位女士后来被证明是一名精神分裂症患者，无法获得药物治疗，她被某种力量拽了出来并被护送走，然后被送进医院观察，这一步骤实际上对每个人来说都比我们任何一个提出指控的人都更安全。我的课继续进行；我们谈论诗歌。尽管我们在校园里的其余日子过得很平静，但我还是感到不安。我无法摆脱这样一种感觉：在这个国家，我们总是生活在难以置信的风险之中。

paragraphs.sourceText: A few months later, crisis 31 again. While my husband was locking his bike to drop off our 3-year-old daughter for her preschool-aged day camp, a different woman approached. Swiftly and for no 32 reason, she bent down, picked up our daughter, and began to carry her down the street. It was so fast and confusing that my daughter 33 cried. My husband, in a burst of speed, chased the woman and reclaimed our daughter. The woman, clearly confused, retreated into the public library. A 34 of homeless people who generally know the other homeless in the area said they did not recognize the woman. The woman was so clearly unwell that when she was taken into custody she was incoherent. Heartbreakingly, she called our daughter by the name of someone else’s child. Each part of the episode was as haunting as it was 35 .
paragraphs.translationZh: 几个月后，危机再次降临。当我丈夫锁上自行车送我们 3 岁的女儿去参加学龄前日营时，另一位女士走了过来。她迅速地、没有任何明显原因地弯下腰，抱起我们的女儿，开始带着她沿着街道走。它是如此之快和令人困惑，以至于我女儿几乎没有哭。我丈夫以极快的速度追赶那个女人，并夺回了我们的女儿。这名女子显然很困惑，退进了公共图书馆。一个通常认识该地区其他无家可归者的无家可归者网络表示，他们不认识这名妇女。该女子明显身体不适，当她被拘留时，她语无伦次。令人心碎的是，她用别人孩子的名字来称呼我们的女儿。这一集的每一部分都既令人难忘又令人恐惧。

paragraphs.sourceText: Directions: In this section, you are going to read a passage with ten statements attached to it. Each statement contains information given in one of the paragraphs. Answer the questions by marking the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2.

paragraphs.sourceText: This man is running 7 marathons on 7 continents in 7 days
paragraphs.translationZh: 这个人在 7 天内跑了 7 个大洲 7 个马拉松

paragraphs.sourceText: A) Michael Wardian pushed forward into the penetrating arctic (北极的) wind, fighting the urge to speed up. Too much effort and he’d begin to sweat, which, he was told, would only increase the risk of hypothermia (体温过低).
paragraphs.translationZh: A) 迈克尔·沃迪安 (Michael Wardian) 迎着刺骨的北极风向前推进，抑制着加速的冲动。如果用力过多，他就会开始出汗，而他被告知，这只会增加体温过低的风险。

paragraphs.sourceText: B) At the 2014 North Pole Marathon, the temperature dipped to minus-22 degrees F, with a wind chill that made it feel even colder. Along the route, armed guards wandered the large sheets of floating ice to minimize the risk of polar bear attacks.
paragraphs.translationZh: B) 2014 年北极马拉松比赛中，气温降至零下 22 华氏度，寒风刺骨，让人感觉更加寒冷。沿途，武装警卫在大片浮冰上行走，以尽量减少北极熊袭击的风险。

paragraphs.sourceText: C) “I like to do stuff that scares me,” Wardian said. With ice frozen to his beard, Wardian crossed the finish line that April afternoon in a winning time of 4 hours 7 minutes and 40 seconds, almost two hours slower than his personal best over 26.2 miles. The race for Wardian, however, was less about the result than overcoming his aversion to the cold.
paragraphs.translationZh: C）“我喜欢做让我害怕的事情，”沃迪安说。 4 月的下午，沃迪安的胡子都结冰了，他以 4 小时 7 分 40 秒的成绩冲过终点线，比他 26.2 英里的个人最好成绩慢了近两个小时。然而，沃迪安的比赛并不是为了结果，而是为了克服他对寒冷的厌恶。

paragraphs.sourceText: D) In a few days, Wardian will once again compete in an unfamiliar territory and below-freezing temperatures. He will line up Monday in Antarctica (南极) for the first leg of the World Marathon Challenge — joining 32 other adventure seekers on an unusual journey where participants travel through different time zones and climates to run seven marathons on seven continents in seven days.
paragraphs.translationZh: D) 几天后，Wardian 将再次在陌生的领域和低于冰点的温度下比赛。他将于周一在南极洲排队参加世界马拉松挑战赛的第一站——与其他 32 名冒险家一起踏上一段不寻常的旅程，参与者穿越不同的时区和气候，在 7 天内跑完七大洲的 7 场马拉松。

paragraphs.sourceText: E) An elite ultra-runner, Wardian has his sights on breaking the event’s record average marathon time of 3:32:25 set last January by U.S. Marine Corps captain Daniel Cartica. Wardian, a 42-year-old Arlington resident, is a record-breaking racer, known in the ultra-running community for seeking tough courses and setting world records. Last year, he ran 1,254.65 miles in 47 races. The World Marathon Challenge, like most of Wardian’s running goals, will be about pushing his limits. “I love diverse and unique challenges,” he said. “I’m definitely interested in seeing what I can handle and what my body can accept. That drives me.”
paragraphs.translationZh: E) Wardian 是一名优秀的超级跑运动员，他的目标是打破美国海军陆战队队长 Daniel Cartica 去年 1 月创下的 3 小时 32 分 25 秒的马拉松平均成绩纪录。沃迪安 (Wardian) 是一位 42 岁的阿灵顿居民，是一位破纪录的赛车手，在超级跑界以追求艰难的路线和创造世界纪录而闻名。去年，他参加了 47 场比赛，跑了 1,254.65 英里。世界马拉松挑战赛与沃迪安的大多数跑步目标一样，都是为了挑战他的极限。 “我喜欢多样化和独特的挑战，”他说。 “我绝对有兴趣看看我能处理什么以及我的身体可以接受什么。这激励着我。”

paragraphs.sourceText: F) Something about the way Richard Donovan carried himself appealed to Wardian. Perhaps it was the sense of adventure Donovan displayed when they first met at the 2010 50K Championships in Galway, Ireland, where Donovan was the race director. The two hit it off, and soon Wardian was participating in Donovan’s events. It was at the North Pole Marathon, a race that Donovan organizes, that Wardian first heard about the Irishman’s plan for the World Marathon Challenge — a challenge that Donovan himself completed in 2009 and 2012. “I knew that many people had a goal of running seven marathons on seven continents during any time period,” Donovan, 50, said. “I felt the natural extension to this idea would be to try to achieve it within a seven-day period.”
paragraphs.translationZh: F) 理查德·多诺万 (Richard Donovan) 的行事风格对沃迪安 (Wardian) 很有吸引力。也许这是多诺万在 2010 年爱尔兰戈尔韦 50K 锦标赛上首次见面时所表现出的冒险精神，当时多诺万担任赛事总监。两人一拍即合，很快沃迪安就参加了多诺万的活动。正是在多诺万组织的北极马拉松比赛中，沃迪恩第一次听说这位爱尔兰人参加世界马拉松挑战赛的计划——多诺万本人在 2009 年和 2012 年完成了这项挑战。“我知道很多人的目标是在任何时期在七大洲跑七场马拉松，”50 岁的多诺万说。 “我觉得这个想法的自然延伸就是努力在 7 天内实现它。”

paragraphs.sourceText: G) Wardian started saving for the trip in 2014, connecting with sponsors and getting approval from his wife, Jennifer, before committing. Registration for the event costs 36,000 euros, which covers international charter flights to each of the seven marathon locations: Union Glacier (Antarctica), Punta Arenas, Chile (South America), Miami (North America), Madrid (Europe), Marrakesh, Morocco (Africa), Dubai (Asia) and Sydney (Australia). The challenge is a test of both physical strength and mental fitness. Sleeping on a crammed plane, adjusting to different time zones and finding food to eat (Wardian is a vegetarian) would make it an exhausting trip over a month, let alone a week. “The key to a race like this is getting comfortable being uncomfortable,” said Becca Pizzi, last year’s women’s champion. “The highs of the race are incredibly high, and the lows incredibly low.”
paragraphs.translationZh: G) Wardian 从 2014 年开始为这次旅行存钱，在做出承诺之前，他与赞助商取得了联系，并得到了妻子 Jennifer 的批准。赛事报名费用为 36,000 欧元，其中包括飞往七个马拉松比赛地点的国际包机费用：联合冰川（南极洲）、蓬塔阿雷纳斯、智利（南美洲）、迈阿密（北美）、马德里（欧洲）、马拉喀什、摩洛哥（非洲）、迪拜（亚洲）和悉尼（澳大利亚）。此次挑战是对体力和心理素质的双重考验。在拥挤的飞机上睡觉、适应不同的时区并寻找食物（沃迪安是素食主义者）会让这成为一个多月的疲惫旅程，更不用说一周了。 “像这样的比赛的关键是要适应不舒服的感觉，”去年的女子冠军贝卡·皮齐 (Becca Pizzi) 说。 “比赛的高潮令人难以置信的高，而低谷则令人难以置信的低。”

paragraphs.sourceText: H) Since turning it into an organized event in 2015, Donovan has attracted a variety of runners. This year’s challenge will feature a far more elite field, which includes Ryan Hall, America’s fastest marathon runner. Despite his proven track record, Hall said he has no time goals and that he still suffers from the same fatigue issues that forced him to leave the professional ranks in 2015. Hall plans to run with his friend, Pastor Matthew Barnett of The Dream Center in Los Angeles — one of the six American men who will be competing. “I don’t expect to run a step with Mike, but I will be excited to see how he does,” said the 34-year-old Hall, who began weight-lifting after retiring. “If I finish within an hour of him in each marathon, I’d be surprised.”
paragraphs.translationZh: H) 自从 2015 年将其变成一项有组织的赛事以来，多诺万吸引了各种各样的跑步者。今年的挑战赛将有更多精英参加，其中包括美国跑得最快的马拉松运动员瑞安·霍尔(Ryan Hall)。尽管有着良好的记录，霍尔表示他没有时间目标，而且他仍然受到同样的疲劳问题的困扰，这迫使他在 2015 年离开职业队伍。霍尔计划与他的朋友、洛杉矶梦想中心的马修·巴尼特牧师一起跑步，他是六名将参加比赛的美国男子之一。 “我不希望和迈克一起跑步，但我很高兴看到他的表现，”34 岁的霍尔说道，他退役后开始举重。 “如果我每次马拉松比赛都比他慢一个小时，我会感到惊讶。”

paragraphs.sourceText: I) Instead, 43-year-old Petr Vabrousek, an elite Czech Ironman champion, is expected to be Wardian’s closest challenger. To others on the trip, simply finishing will be its own reward. Sinead Kane of Ireland is aiming to become the first blind person to complete the challenge. And Beth Ann Telford, a 47-year-old federal government worker from Fairfax and the only American female in this year’s mix, is using the event as a platform to raise money for cancer research. It’s a cause with a personal connection to Telford, who was diagnosed with brain cancer in 2004. “Doing something like this is definitely the hardest challenge that I’ve ever done except for the chemotherapy and brain surgery,” she said. “It’s going to raise awareness... I just wanted to do something that is epic and this certainly is right up there.” Wardian, too, hopes his involvement will give him a platform to promote a cause. He recently became an ambassador for the United Nations Women’s HeForShe initiative to fight inequalities faced by women and girls worldwide.
paragraphs.translationZh: I) 相反，43 岁的捷克铁人三项精英冠军 Petr Vabrousek 预计将成为 Wardian 最接近的挑战者。对于旅途中的其他人来说，简单地完成任务本身就是一种奖励。爱尔兰的西尼德·凯恩 (Sinead Kane) 的目标是成为第一个完成这项挑战的盲人。贝丝·安·特尔福德 (Beth Ann Telford) 是来自费尔法克斯的 47 岁联邦政府工作人员，也是今年参赛名单中唯一的美国女性，她正在利用该活动作为为癌症研究筹集资金的平台。这项事业与特尔福德有着个人联系，特尔福德于 2004 年被诊断出患有脑癌。“做这样的事情绝对是我除了化疗和脑部手术之外做过的最艰巨的挑战，”她说。 “这会提高人们的认识……我只是想做一些史诗般的事情，而这当然就是其中之一。”沃迪安也希望他的参与能为他提供一个推动事业的平台。他最近成为联合国妇女署“HeForShe”倡议的大使，该倡议旨在对抗全世界妇女和女童面临的不平等现象。

paragraphs.sourceText: J) On a chilly December afternoon, Wardian wove through Washington’s crowded sidewalks on the way home from his full-time job as an international ship broker. His elastic, 6-foot frame bounced gently and efficiently off the ground with each step of the hilly six-mile trip back to Arlington. This is a daily routine during the week for Wardian, who started racing professionally in 2003 and runs seven days a week, often multiple times a day. When he travels, he prefers to explore new places on his feet.
paragraphs.translationZh: J) 12 月一个寒冷的下午，沃迪安在结束国际船舶经纪人的全职工作回家的路上穿过华盛顿拥挤的人行道。在返回阿灵顿的六英里丘陵之旅中，他那富有弹性的 6 英尺身躯在每一步中都从地面轻轻有效地弹起。这是 Wardian 一周的日常工作，他于 2003 年开始职业比赛，每周运行 7 天，通常每天运行多次。当他旅行时，他更喜欢用脚探索新的地方。

paragraphs.sourceText: K) But in some ways, Wardian still has trouble thinking of himself as a runner. For the majority of his childhood, Wardian devoted his energy to becoming a Division I lacrosse (长曲棍球) player — a dream he realized when he was recruited to play at Michigan State University. “Once he decides to do something, he just works at it until he does it,” Michael’s younger sister, Mariele, said. “Once he decides to do it, it’s usually something that’s going to happen. He’s always been like that. He’s a very motivated individual.”
paragraphs.translationZh: K) 但在某些方面，沃迪安仍然很难将自己视为一名跑步者。在童年的大部分时间里，沃迪安都把精力投入到成为一名长曲棍球一级运动员上——当他被密歇根州立大学录取时，他实现了这个梦想。 “一旦他决定做某事，他就会一直努力直到做到为止，”迈克尔的妹妹玛丽埃勒说。 “一旦他决定这样做，通常就会发生一些事情。他一直都是这样。他是一个非常有动力的人。”

paragraphs.sourceText: L) It was only a year or so ago that Wardian realized that he had been a runner longer than a lacrosse player. It was not until he ran in the 2004 U.S. Olympic Marathon Trials — the first of three for Wardian — that he felt that he was a legitimate runner. Now more than 10 years and numerous ultramarathon national titles and world records later, he embraces that identity. Wardian wants to see how far his legs can take him, one epic challenge at a time. “I want to always keep doing things that are exciting, adventurous, different and most importantly, probably things I’m not the best at,” Wardian said, “because if you’re not seeking things out that are challenging and difficult for you, then you’re not growing... So I hope maybe people see what I do, and say, ‘Okay, I want to do something different or try something new... I’m going to do something that scares me.’ That’s what I’m hoping people will take from it.”

paragraphs.translationZh: 第 46 至 50 题基于以下段落。

paragraphs.sourceText: Many people associate their self-worth with their work. The more successful their career, the better they feel about themselves. Work-related self-esteem is therefore a worthy ideal to pursue with vigor, right? Well, not always. According to recent research, in which psychologists interviewed 370 full-time workers over a period of three weeks, the reality is a little more complicated. And it involves negative as well as positive consequences.
paragraphs.translationZh: 许多人将自我价值与工作联系起来。他们的事业越成功，他们对自己的感觉就越好。因此，与工作相关的自尊是一个值得大力追求的理想，对吗？嗯，并非总是如此。最近的一项研究显示，心理学家在三周内采访了 370 名全职工人，结果显示现实情况要复杂一些。它涉及消极和积极的后果。

paragraphs.sourceText: It’s natural to be drawn towards pleasure and to step away from pain. In the workplace, if that pleasure comes from a triumph which swells our self-respect, people will try to repeat the accomplishment. But repeating that accomplishment is often not realistic, which can lead to severe negative emotional consequences when it doesn’t reoccur. This form of motivation is widely regarded as a negative type of motivation. It can hinder other more positive motivation types, such as completing a task purely because it’s fulfilling or enjoyable.
paragraphs.translationZh: 被快乐所吸引并远离痛苦是很自然的。在工作场所，如果这种快乐来自于提升我们自尊的胜利，人们就会试图重复这种成就。但重复这一成就通常是不现实的，当它不再发生时，可能会导致严重的负面情绪后果。这种形式的动机被广泛认为是消极类型的动机。它可能会阻碍其他更积极的动机类型，例如纯粹因为有成就感或令人愉快而完成任务。

paragraphs.sourceText: What consumes the employee instead is a pressing need to feel mighty and sure of themselves. They then take on only tasks and objectives which serve that ego-driven need. As a result, to avoid feelings of shame and worthlessness associated with failure, they extend themselves to such a degree that there’s a subsequent adverse effect on their well-being. This internal pressure to succeed at all costs demands a lot of effort. It depletes their energy, culminating in disproportionate levels of damaging sentiment.
paragraphs.translationZh: 相反，消耗员工的是对自己强大和自信的迫切需要。然后，他们只承担满足自我驱动需求的任务和目标。因此，为了避免与失败相关的羞耻感和无价值感，他们将自己延伸到了对他们的福祉产生不利影响的程度。这种不惜一切代价取得成功的内在压力需要付出很大的努力。它耗尽了他们的精力，最终导致了不成比例的破坏性情绪。

paragraphs.sourceText: Those negative emotions mount into heightened anxiety, impacting their ability to make the most of their personal life. Their desire to avoid feeling inferior ends up making them feel inferior when it comes to their diminished capacity for friendship and leisure. They end up dissatisfied both at work and outside of it.
paragraphs.translationZh: 这些负面情绪会加剧焦虑，影响他们充分利用个人生活的能力。他们避免感到自卑的愿望最终使他们在友谊和休闲能力下降时感到自卑。他们最终对工作和工作之外都不满意。

paragraphs.sourceText: But thankfully, for those people compelled almost entirely by this specific form of motivation, the news isn’t all bad, or bad at all. The study also discovered several positive outcomes that can actually outweigh the harmful ones. Though these types of employees are motivated by the desire to avoid negative consequences, they are also motivated by the excitement of pursuing emotional rewards. This excitement makes pursuing goals enjoyable and stimulates pleasure and pride that would result from success. An effect of the positive motivation is that it neutralizes the existence of negative motivation.
paragraphs.translationZh: 但值得庆幸的是，对于那些几乎完全被这种特定形式的动机所驱使的人来说，这个消息并不全是坏事，或者根本就不是坏事。该研究还发现了一些积极的结果，这些结果实际上可以超过有害的结果。尽管这些类型的员工的动机是避免负面后果，但他们也受到追求情感奖励的兴奋的动机。这种兴奋使追求目标变得愉快，并激发成功带来的快乐和自豪感。积极动机的一个作用是它抵消了消极动机的存在。

paragraphs.sourceText: Sure, it affects people’s personal lives to what could be deemed an unhealthy extent, because leisure activities are often seen as a part of life that must be sacrificed to manage work and family demands. However, the way people feel about their work has less to do with whether they’re motivated by the preservation of self-esteem but more with the fact that they’re simply motivated.
paragraphs.translationZh: 当然，它对人们的个人生活的影响可能达到了不健康的程度，因为休闲活动通常被视为生活的一部分，必须牺牲来满足工作和家庭需求。然而，人们对工作的感受与他们是否出于维护自尊的动机关系不大，而更多地与他们只是有动机这一事实有关。

paragraphs.sourceText: Questions 51 to 55 are based on the following passage.
paragraphs.translationZh: 问题 51 至 55 基于以下段落。

paragraphs.sourceText: Degradation of the world’s natural resources by humans is rapidly outpacing the planet’s ability to absorb the damage, a recent UN environmental study has found. The study concludes that without radical action the level of prosperity that millions of people in the developed world count on will be impossible to maintain or extend to poorer countries.
paragraphs.translationZh: 联合国最近的一项环境研究发现，人类对世界自然资源的退化正在迅速超过地球吸收破坏的能力。该研究的结论是，如果不采取激进行动，发达国家数百万人所依赖的繁荣水平将无法维持或扩展到较贫穷国家。

paragraphs.sourceText: Water scarcity is the curse of some of the poorest regions on Earth, leaving developing countries increasingly unable to feed themselves, and causing hardship for millions of people. There appears little prospect of this desperate situation being remedied without radical action being taken. Water sources are under increasing threat from population growth, climate change, rapid urbanisation, rising levels of consumption, and the degradation of lands that previously provided a natural replenishment (补充) of water resources.
paragraphs.translationZh: 水资源短缺是地球上一些最贫困地区的祸根，导致发展中国家越来越无法养活自己，并给数百万人带来了困难。如果不采取激进的行动，这种绝望的局面似乎很难得到补救。由于人口增长、气候变化、快速城市化、消费水平上升以及以前提供水资源自然补充的土地退化，水源正面临越来越大的威胁。

paragraphs.sourceText: The rate of damage to the natural environment was found to increase globally, despite concerted efforts to persuade governments to take measures to improve the condition. “If current trends continue, and the world fails to improve patterns of production and consumption, then the state of the world’s environment will continue to decline,” warned UN executive director Achim Steiner.
paragraphs.translationZh: 尽管我们共同努力说服各国政府采取措施改善自然环境，但全球范围内自然环境的破坏率仍在增加。联合国执行主任阿奇姆·施泰纳警告说：“如果目前的趋势持续下去，而世界未能改善生产和消费模式，那么世界环境状况将继续恶化。”

paragraphs.sourceText: He said the tools for improving the environment for millions of people existed in developed countries, but were in danger of not being used.
paragraphs.translationZh: 他说，发达国家已有改善数百万人环境的工具，但面临着不被使用的危险。

paragraphs.sourceText: The study found that basic measures to tackle some of the key causes of environmental damage were still not being taken. These included measures to reduce air pollution; to control the damage to marine eco-systems, which can have a huge effect on fish stocks on which hundreds of millions of people depend; and to curb the degradation of land where modern agricultural methods were pursued without regard to the longer-term consequences.
paragraphs.translationZh: 研究发现，仍未采取基本措施来解决造成环境破坏的一些关键原因。其中包括减少空气污染的措施；控制对海洋生态系统的破坏，这可能对数亿人赖以生存的鱼类种群产生巨大影响；并在不顾长期后果而追求现代农业方法的情况下遏制土地退化。

paragraphs.sourceText: Despite the recent global agreement on cutting greenhouse gas emissions, global carbon output continues to rise. This will put a long-term strain on the ability of developing economies to feed their own people. Climate change is aggravated by the emissions of greenhouse gases from chemical and natural fertilisers used in agriculture which increased by more than a quarter between 2000 and 2010. Other problem areas identified in the report included glaciers, which provide vital water resources for millions of people, but which are shrinking as the climate warms.
paragraphs.translationZh: 尽管最近达成了减少温室气体排放的全球协议，但全球碳排放量仍在持续上升。这将对发展中经济体养活本国人民的能力造成长期压力。农业中使用的化学肥料和天然肥料的温室气体排放量在2000年至2010年间增加了四分之一以上，加剧了气候变化。报告中指出的其他问题领域包括冰川，它为数百万人提供重要的水资源，但随着气候变暖，冰川正在萎缩。

paragraphs.sourceText: In rich countries, these problems have built up over decades and centuries while economic growth was pursued at the expense of the environment. Subsequent efforts to remedy the environment have met with partial success. But in developing countries, the path of future development has more potential to change, which has encouraged international institutions to devise more sustainable growth pathways that are supposed both to alleviate poverty and preserve the environment.
paragraphs.translationZh: 在富裕国家，这些问题是在数十年和数百年的时间里积累起来的，而经济增长是以牺牲环境为代价的。随后的环境治理努力取得了部分成功。但在发展中国家，未来发展道路有更大的改变潜力，这鼓励国际机构设计更可持续的增长道路，既能减轻贫困，又能保护环境。
